feeds.title: Presbyterian Outlook
feeds.description: The Presbyterian Outlook is the website of the Presbyterian Outlook, an independent magazine covering news, resources, and ideas for those in the PC(USA) and everyone interested in discussing church, life, and faith. The Presbyterian Outlook is a valuable resource for anyone interested in learning more about Presbyterianism or engaging in thoughtful conversation about faith and life.

feeds.title: Union Presbyterian Seminary Blog
feeds.description: Read the recent news and blogs, as well as the Black Alumni Association Newsletter. Union Presbyterian Seminary equips Christian leaders for ministry in the world a sacred vocation that requires deep learning, commitment to service, and an ability to read culture and circumstance in the light of the rich resources of scripture and theological tradition.

feeds.title: The Presbyterian Church in Canada News
feeds.description: Relying on the power of the Holy Spirit, we proclaim the love and good news of Jesus Christ through our words and actions.

feeds.title: Presbyterian Senior Living
feeds.description: Presbyterian Senior Living(PSL) is a not-for-profit organization, providing retirement and senior care services for more than 85 years. The mission of Presbyterian Senior Living is to provide compassionate, vibrant and supportive communities and services to promote wholeness of body, mind and spirit.

feeds.title: NEXT Church Blog
feeds.description: NEXT Church is a purposeful relational community of Presbyterian leaders whose mission is to strengthen a vibrant and thriving PC(USA) that shares the good news of Jesus Christ in ways that matter to and have impact on God's evolving world.

feeds.title: Presbyterian Women Blog
feeds.description: Covers Bible Study, Churchwide Gathering, Racial Equity, Nurturing Faith, and Building Community. Presbyterian Women is a women's organization in the Presbyterian Church (USA). We provide information about justice & peace and ministry to inform mission and community-building work.

feeds.title: ByFaith Magazine
feeds.description: byFaith's mission is to draw readers into the full life of the Church by informing, edifying, and encouraging them with the news of God's kingdom. Through articles, the magazine motivates and equips readers to serve Christ in the PCA and in His kingdom.

feeds.title: Lookout Mountain Presbyterian Church
feeds.description: Weekly sermons from the Fellowship Hall service at Lookout Mountain Presbyterian Church.

feeds.title: The Outreach Foundation - Trips Blog
feeds.description: The Outreach Foundation connects Presbyterians and others with people, projects and partnerships around the world, fostering relationships that build the capacity of the church in the U.S. and around the world for participation in God's mission. We believe that the good news of Jesus Christ should be shared in word and deed with all the peoples of the world.

feeds.title: First Presbyterian Church Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to First Presbyterian Church. In everything we do we will love first; God, each other, and our neighbours. Live and worship in joyful relationship with God. Open ourselves to one another as a diverse community of Spirit. Venture together on a hopeful journey into healing, overflowing life through Christ. Engage together in a life of service for our downtown neighbours and the wider world.

feeds.title: Chapel Hill Presbyterian Church Blog
feeds.description: Chapel Hill is a community of faithful followers of Jesus working together to present everyone mature in Christ. We have adopted the Evangelical Presbyterian Church's statement of belief. This includes a prologue about God's Word and seven statements that outline an evangelical, reformed understanding about the Trinity, Jesus, the Holy Spirit, salvation, the Church, Jesus' return and mission.

feeds.title: The Christian Observer
feeds.description: Serving The Presbyterian and Reformed Community Since 1813.

feeds.title: Discover St. Mark
feeds.description: St. Mark Presbyterian Church is mission-minded, with a strong commitment to sharing God's love with our neighbours and our world.

feeds.title: Trinity Presbyterian Church Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Trinity Presbyterian Church. We believe that Jesus Christ rescues people from the emptiness of life and invites them to live life to the full.

feeds.title: Plainfield Christian Church
feeds.description: Weekly messages from Plainfield Christian Church, in Plainfield, IN.

feeds.title: Like the Great Mountains
feeds.description: Articles devoted primarily to short regular devotionals through consecutive portions of Scripture as well as topical articles that are developed out of ministry in the local church. Ben is a husband, father of five, and elder at Redeemer OPC in Atlanta, GA where he labors alongside his fellow elders inside the church for the growth of each member and visitor in the grace and knowledge of the Lord Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: First Presbyterian Day School » Articles
feeds.description: At First Presbyterian Day School we exist for the purpose of 'educating and equipping students to change the world for God's glory.' These values include seeking to Glorify God in everything we do and say, teaching a Biblical World Life View, Supporting Families, Pursuing Excellence, Maintaining Integrity and a continual commitment to Advancing God's Kingdom in all of our pursuits.

feeds.title: Tates Creek Presbyterian Church - Robert's Blog
feeds.description: We are a PCA church in Lexington, KY that exists 'for the glory of Christ and the good of the Bluegrass.'

feeds.title: Friendship Presbyterian Church Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Friendship Presbyterian Church. Thoughts on faith and life at Friendship Church.

feeds.title: Presbytery of Giddings-Lovejoy Blog
feeds.description: The Presbytery of Giddings-Lovejoy is a regional Council of the Presbyterian Church (USA) with 79 congregations in Missouri and Illinois. A Community of Vibrant Congregations and Dynamic Leaders.

feeds.title: Govans Presbyterian Church
feeds.description: Govans Church is a progressive, inclusive, loving, faith community. We are a More Light congregation, and are committed to the full participation of all members in the life of the church. We are working for social, racial and economic justice. Together, we are on a transforming lifelong spiritual journey.

feeds.title: The First Presbyterian Church of Newhall Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a place to openly discuss and share ideas. As Presbyterians we are all encouraged to read, study and pray scripture both alone and in community. We are to also pray that we may be guided by the Holy Spirit to live scripture. Paul tells us we must treat each other with humility and gentleness in our disagreements.

feeds.title: Pratt Presbyterian Church
feeds.description: A Presbyterian Church Blog.

feeds.title: Presbyterian Plodder
feeds.description: Comment from an evangelical presbyterian perspective and an orthodox confessionally reformed outlook.

feeds.title: Presbyterian Church
feeds.description: The Presbyterian Mission Agency is the ministry and mission agency of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.). Presbyterians affirm that God comes to us with grace and love in the person of Jesus Christ, who lived, died, and rose for us so that we might have eternal and abundant life in him.

feeds.title: Redeemer Presbyterian Church Blog
feeds.description: Redeemer Presbyterian Church exists to glorify God as a Gospel presence in downtown Charleston by being a grace-filled community that worships Christ and develops disciples who serve Him in our families, neighborhoods, and the nations.

feeds.title: Westminster Presbyterian Church
feeds.description: Founded in 1861, Westminster is a metropolitan church in every sense of the word. From our location in the heart of Grand Rapids, we attract a diverse congregation from all parts of the city. We believe that this diversity is one of our greatest strengths. Westminster Presbyterian Church is a community of Christians committed to the common purpose of praising God, learning from God's Word.

feeds.title: Eastminster Presbyterian Church Blog
feeds.description: Eastminster is a gospel-centered, people-loving, Evangelical Presbyterian church. Our mission is to Glorify God. Follow Christ. Transform Lives. We do this through Worship, Discipleship and Service.
